title: Mixed Event — Bustling Cafe ●REC! — Episode5 The Kitchen's At Capacity!

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP!'s latest gig is a TV segment on location at a popular cafe! Little do they realize, it's none other than the cafe where Minori works!

rows.Line: carino/carina

rows.Speaker: Wrestlers
rows.Line:
Mmm!
That parfait was amazing, but these waffles are also mega good♪

rows.Speaker: Wrestlers
rows.Line: There's always some sort of catch involved with the cafes and stuff that go viral online, but everything this place serves is so good! And they come in generous amounts!

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line:
Definitely.
Why don't we keep going and try everything that's on the menu? The waffles were great, so...

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line:
Excuse me!
Can we have eight of your old-fashioned coffee jelly? And five more plates of these waffles!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Eep...!
They're ordering more...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we still haven't finished making their last order...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They ordered six earlier, and asked for five more... So, twelve in total...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Saki, hang in there!
Even doing simple addition is starting to become a challenge!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And I'm not gonna be able to finish all these in time...)

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Sweets really are the best! Let's think about what to order next while we wait for our waffles to get here♪

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line:
Excuse me!
We'd also like to order!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Th-This is bad...
If we don't get these out soon, we won't be able to start on the other customers' orders.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But what can we do...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We apologize for interrupting your wonderful meal! But may we have a quick word?!

rows.Speaker: Wrestlers
rows.Line:
Oh, hey!
Isn't this the shoot you were talking about?!

rows.Speaker: Wrestlers
rows.Line:
Cool!
We get to be on your show?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. If possible, we'd like the cooperation of all the customers in this cafe.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Ohh...!
I didn't notice at first, but aren't you Riser☆Fujin, the professional wrestler?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I can't believe you're really here!
Would you mind telling me how you're enjoying your parfait?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(...!
Nice one, Minori!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But we're also gonna need to start working on her acting skills since she's gonna need them moving forward...)

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
I couldn't be happier that you want to interview us for your show!

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line:
So, where should I start?
We've actually just finished going through the second page of this menu.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's impressive!
Then, would you mind telling us all which you recommend the most...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Now I see!
They're running cover for us...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Saki, this is our chance!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Airi and the others are interviewing that group to keep them from ordering even more stuff!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which makes this our chance to get these orders out!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Airi is...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy Everyday really is the best!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's get to work!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Still, I'm honestly staggered.
I'd heard rumors, but to see that you can all eat so much...

rows.Speaker: Wrestlers
rows.Line:
Of course we can!
Also, we've been seeing some people take pictures of their food without actually eating it! If we catch anyone doing that, they get to be on the wrong end of a German suplex!

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line: Each establishment does its best to produce high-quality dishes, so we want to respect the hard work they put in!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting!
Eight more coffee jellies and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Eleven plates of waffles!
We'll just leave them here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...
Mizuki and Saki seem much more relaxed now.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Also, I'm really glad Ms. Fujin agreed to do this interview for us.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And I bet the producers are gonna be ecstatic when they hear that we managed to grab a few sound bites from an influencer like her.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (She's so charismatic and always says the funniest things! We couldn't ask for juicier footage!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Huh? Isn't that...?)

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Wow...
It smells so nice in here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, it's like the sweet and fluffy kingdom of yummy treats! I feel even hungrier than before!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! Hi, Saki!
And Mizuki?!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, Emu, are they friends of yours?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
This is Mizuki! And this is Saki! She's Tsukasa's little sister!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
It's nice to meet both of you. My name is Hinata. I'm Emu's big sister.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're her big sister?!
Thank you for always looking after Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, wait a second. Mizuki, I didn't know you also worked here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, actually, I'm just helping for the day.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They needed an extra hand because of this shoot they're doing right now for a TV show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: For TV?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I know, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See over there? They're shooting right now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, wow!
It's everyone from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, the cafe's bustling with more activity than usual today... If you're okay with a little bit of background noise, I'm sure you'll still enjoy your visit♪

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Thank you.
We'll be more than happy to stay.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
So, two Mount Everest strawberry parfaits please!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, that was fast!
Did you two plan on getting these from the start?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
I wanted to give it a try after Sis' friends told us about it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wow.
It really has gone viral.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, it's pretty big. Are you sure about getting two? Splitting one might be a better option...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We'll be fine!
I can fit a lot into my tummy, but Sis can eat even more!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Interesting. She definitely doesn't give off that sort of vibe.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay!
We'll get started on your order right away!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Great, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Two Mount Everest strawberry parfaits...
That should be a piece of cake for us now!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that group's onslaught of orders definitely helped me get up to speed!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, Airi and the others stopped them just in time. We have a chance to work on everyone else's orders now.

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
All this talking is making me hungry.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki & Saki
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line: This interview's given our stomachs a chance to digest everything. I think we're all ready for another round!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A-Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Wrestlers
rows.Line: We're like starving wolves after matches. Also, we haven't touched the third page of this menu yet. So...

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line:
Let's start the second half!
For now, eight of your cream-tastic mille-feuilles and twenty of your fruit macaron sets please!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki & Saki
rows.Line: Whaaaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They just screamed again...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And we shouldn't overstay our welcome...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This is probably it for our interview. We've gotten a lot out of them and probably have more than enough good footage.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But if we don't do something...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (The entire cafe is going to get hectic again and the staff might not be able to attend to the other customers.)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: This could be bad...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (The manager's had a worried look for a while now. It wouldn't be right for us to just go back to shooting...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Isn't there anything we can do...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-You know!
Everybody working here is wearing such cute uniforms! I wish I could try one on!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
How amazing would it be to work here?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Minori...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's a pretty bold suggestion!
Don't come crying to me when the staff scolds you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, um... I-I'm sorry!
I just blurted out the first thing that popped into my head!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, that does sound fun...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would it be possible for us to help making parfaits and such?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Y-Yes.
Waiting tables and serving food sounds fun, but so does making parfaits.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Yes, they caught on...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa, hold up! You two agree with her?! Think about the manager! It's not easy to juggle all these new employees!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
No, don't mind me...!
I was actually hoping to show what goes on in the kitchen.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: And we just happen to have an extra uniform available. Please feel free to try it on!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(The manager caught on and went along so naturally.
Thank goodness...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
We should see what the director has to say!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Great!
We just got the green light!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, following a sudden turn of events...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's time for MMJ's Impromptu Cafe featuring carino/carina!
